title: Most Claude Code Users Are Making This Setup Mistake
description:
Most Claude Code users are wasting time before they even write their first line of code.

Anthropic just released Claude Code Setup, a plugin that analyzes your project and recommends the best development setup automatically.
Instead of manually figuring out your workflow, you run one command.

It scans your codebase and suggests the right hooks, skills, sub-agents, and MCP servers based on what you're building.

Building an app? It recommends the MCP servers you'll likely need.
Working on a larger codebase? It can suggest review agents to help catch potential issues before they become bigger problems.

The best part is the entire setup takes less than 30 seconds.
The shift isn't better coding.
It's spending less time configuring your environment and more time building.
